title: Begin under the Name before anything else
summary: The opening places the heart under the One, Truth, and the Guru's grace. Return the tired body to refuge before asking more of it.
takeaway: Return the tired body to refuge before asking more of it.
lifeApplication: When force is failing, stop performing strength, sit down, and let one line carry the next breath.

source.shortMeaning: The opening places the heart under the One, Truth, and the Guru's grace.
source.lifeApplication: When weariness scatters you, begin again under the Name before reaching for relief.
